title: Experts read from an immutable file behind a bounded host tier
description: ssd-expert-materialization's FileExpertSource: every expert is written once to a file and read back checked against its SHA-256, through the HostExpertTier that keeps recently read experts in host memory (host_bytes, the bytes host-memory admission granted; 0 for none). The file is immutable once read, so every expert is added before the first matrices(). FP64 rows here; an engine stores its checkpoint encoding and decodes it in its kernels. Its bundle store (experts:store): open_store(layout, layers, experts, device, path=None, identity=None) -> FileBundleStore (csf_scales: CSF scales kept compressed), the file tier: every bundle in one file (built by put(), or a complete file with the same layout reopened), read on demand by lookup-table-rows' native row reader (readers threads, the bundles its rows) behind the same bounded host tier; it has no device-readable region, so a device expert cache fills from it with read() on the host (not captured).

readers.description: threads reading bundles from the store file

csf_scales.description: scale components of the experts plugin's slot layout the store keeps CSF-compressed, with the exception words each bundle holds for each ("gate_up_scale:256,down_scale:128"; ModelOpt's encoding, about half the bytes of E4M3 scales): put() encodes them from the slot-layout bundle or takes the checkpoint's (compressed=), the device expert cache rebuilds the slot layout as it fills slots (no CPU tier over such a store); empty: the slot layout as it is
